t: Proclaimed on 1 December 1918 as the Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes, it united Serbia, Montenegro and former Habsburg lands.
Conflict between Serbian centralism and Croatian autonomy led to the royal dictatorship of 1929 and the name Yugoslavia.
The Axis invasion of April 1941 destroyed the kingdom in eleven days and partitioned it among its enemies.
dyk: King Alexander’s assassination in Marseille in 1934 was filmed by newsreel cameramen, making it one of the first political assassinations recorded on film.
ev: The Corfu Declaration agrees on a South Slav kingdom under the Karađorđević dynasty
The Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes is proclaimed in Belgrade
The centralist Vidovdan Constitution is adopted
Stjepan Radić is shot in parliament and dies weeks later
King Alexander imposes a dictatorship and renames the country Yugoslavia
King Alexander is assassinated in Marseille
The Cvetković-Maček Agreement creates the Banovina of Croatia
Germany and its allies invade and the army surrenders on 17 April

f.predecessor: Kingdom of Serbia; State of Slovenes, Croats and Serbs; Kingdom of Montenegro
f.successor: Democratic Federal Yugoslavia (later the Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia)
